a: Yazaalibwa nga ayitibwa Hannah Tatum Whitall nga 7 Febwali 1832 mu Philadelphia, mu maka g'Abakwakeri agaamanyibwa era agatya Katonda. Kitaawe, John Mickle Whitall, ne nnyina, Mary Tatum Whitall, baamukuza nga Munnaffe "ow'obuzaale" mu nkola ya Gurney ey'enjiri. "Buli kigambo, endowooza, n'ekikolwa eky'obulamu bwaffe byali binnyikiziddwa mu Bukwakeri," bwe yajjukira. Amaka gaali muntu w'omukwakeri ng'akola, nga gaawaayo amaanyi gaago mu bikolwa by'enkyukakyuka eby'ekiseera ekyo, ng'agaana obuddu era ng'awagira okulongoosa embeera z'abantu.

Ng'abakazi abasinga ab'omulembe gwe, teyagoberera kkubo ly'okusoma erya bulijjo, kubanga yunivasite z'ekiseera kye zaali nziggale nnyo ku bakazi. Mu kifo ky'ekyo yafuna awaka okutendekebwa okw'amaanyi mu bwongo ne mu mpisa okwo amaka g'Abakwakeri agaayigirizibwa obulungi gaatwalanga nga kya muwendo, okwakolebwa okusinga byonna okussa essira kw'Abakwakeri ku kufumiitiriza n'okussaayo omwoyo ku "Kitangaala eky'omunda." Abasomi oluvannyuma baagamba nti obusobozi bwe obw'okunnyonnyola amazima ag'omwoyo ag'obuziba mu lulimi olwangu bwali bumu ku nsonga enkulu ezaaleetera ebitabo bye okwagalibwa ennyo.

q: Okunoonya kwe okuwanvu okw'omwoyo kwali kutya?
a: Okuzuukuka kwe kwajja lwa kwewuunya so si lwa kutya — nga aweza emyaka nga kkumi na mukaaga yalengera "obukulu bwa Katonda obw'ekitalo," era "awo era mu kaseera ako, okunoonya kwange kwatandika." Naye kwali, mu bujulizi bwe, "okunoonya okwa bumuzibe era okutamanya," era ekitabo kye eky'ennaku eky'olubereberye "lukalala lumu oluwanvu olw'okulwana n'okubonaabona, nga kuliko akatangaala k'ekitangaala akatono." Yawandiika ku kintu kimu kye yali tasobola kwekolera: "Simanyi okusaba ... siyinza kufuuka mutuukirivu ddala okutuusa lwe nneenenya, ate siyinza kwenenya."

Mu 1865, ng'amaze emyaka mwenda ng'Omukristaayo naye nga "bulijjo nneemulugunya ku bwange," yazuula nti okuwonyezebwa mu maanyi g'ekibi — si mu kibonerezo kyakyo kyokka — mulimu gwa Katonda okutuukiriza mu abo abeewaayo gy'ali. Yafunza ensonga yonna mu bigambo bina, "Si nze, wabula Kristo," ne mu sentensi emu: "omulimu gw'omuntu kwe kwesiga, n'omulimu gwa Katonda kwe kukola."

Kyafulumizibwa mu 1875, era yakiyita "ekyama," bwe yannyonnyola, olw'okuba kyali kimaze ebbanga eddene nga kikwekedde ye. Ekifaananyi kyakyo ekimanyiddwa ennyo kye ky'omutambuze akkiriza okusitulwa mu kigaali naye n'asigaza omugugu omuzito ku bibegabega bye — obulamu bw'Ekikristaayo, yayigiriza, kutegeeza ku nkomerero okuteeka wansi obuzito bwonna. Akatabo akatono kaatundibwa ebisukka mu bukadde bubiri mu bulamu bwe, kaavvuunulwa mu nnimi nnyingi, era tekaalekera awo kufulumizibwa.

q: Yakola kinnyonnyi ki mu ntambula ey'Obulamu Obw'ekitiibwa ne Keswick?
a: Ab'omu Smith baasomoka mu Bungereza mu 1873 ne 1874, gye okusoma Bayibuli kwa Hannah okw'obukkakkamu era okw'okulowooza kwamuleetera okwagalibwa ennyo — baamutuuma "malayika w'amakanisa." Enkuŋŋaana zaabwe, mwe muli enkuŋŋaana ez'amaanyi ez'e Broadlands, zaayamba okuzaala mu 1875 Olukuŋŋaana lwa Keswick. Okumala ekiseera yali limu ku maloboozi agaasinga okumanyika mu ntambula ey'Obulamu Obw'ekitiibwa etaali ya kibiina kimu, naddala wakati mu bakazi.

Mu 1875 obuweereza bwa bba Robert obw'olwatu bwakoma mangu wakati mu bulumirizi obw'empisa embi, era oluvannyuma n'aseeyeeya okuva mu kukkiriza kwe baali bagabana n'ayingira mu kubuusabuusa Katonda. Ku baana be omusanvu, bana baafa mu buvubuka; n'abasatu abaawona okutuuka mu bukulu baaggwaamu okukkiriza kye yali awaayo byonna okusiimisa — muwala we Alys n'afumbirwa omulowooza Bertrand Russell. Ennaku zino yazisisinkana si na kugaana wabula n'enjigiriza yennyini gye yabuulira.

q: Yakola atya ku njawulo wakati w'okukkiriza n'okuwulira?
a: Yagaana okuzimba okukkiriza ku kuwulira: "newankubadde okuwulira okulungi wadde okuwulira okubi tekukyusa ekituufu." Yayagalanga okujuliza Luteeri, eyaddamu Setaani bwe yamubuuza oba yawulira nti yali mwana wa Katonda: "Nedda, sikiwulira n'akatono, naye nkimanyi." Enjawulo eyo — wakati w'ekituufu eky'okwagala kwa Katonda n'okuwulira kwaffe okukyukakyuka — kwe kwali ettaka lye yayimirirako ettaka bwe lyayuuguuma.

q: Ebitabo bye eby'oluvannyuma byayigiriza ki ku Katonda?
a: Nti Katonda gwe yali alowoozanga nga "omu ku bantu ab'omululu era abeefaako bokka mu nsi yonna" yali mu mazima "ekyawukanako ddala." Obutaba n'Omululu bwa Katonda (1903) bulambika obulamu bwe ng'olukalala lw'"ebiseera" eby'eddiini, ate Katonda ow'Okubudaabuda Kwonna (1906) kukakaatika okulaba kwa Kitaffe okwagala kwe kusukka n'okwa maama. Okumanya "nti Katonda y'ali, era nti Katonda amala," yagamba, kwafuula "okufa ekisuubizo eky'essanyu ku biseera eby'omu maaso."

q: Kiki ekirala kye yeewaayo gye kiri, era yakomekkereza atya?
a: Ku ludda lw'okuwandiika kwe yeewaayo mu nkyukakyuka — ng'ayamba okutandika Kibiina ky'Abakazi Abakristaayo Abaziyiza Omwenge mu 1874, ng'alwanirira eddembe ly'abakazi okwogera mu lujjudde mu by'eddiini, era ng'ayogera ku lw'abakazi okulonda. Mu myaka gye egy'oluvannyuma obulwadde bw'ennyingo bwamusibira mu kagaali k'abalema era mu bulumi bungi, naye endowooza ye yeeyongera okwakaayakana. Yafiira mu Bungereza nga 1 Maayi 1911, ng'aweza emyaka nsanvu mu mwenda, nga tawanguddwa bufumbo obwalumizibwa, amalaalo amana amatono, wadde abaana abaava mu kukkiriza kwe.
